name: David Bowie

whyMatters.en: Solo artist filed here as a band-node: glam, Berlin trilogy, and Let’s Dance show persona and production shifts as a working method from 1969 onward.
whyMatters.zh: 以乐队节点收录的独唱歌手：从 1969 年起，glam、柏林三部曲与 Let’s Dance 把人设与制作切换当成工作方法。

note.en: Ziggy-era glam: Ronson guitar, Top of the Pops arm-around cue.
note.zh: Ziggy 时期 glam：Ronson 吉他、Top of the Pops 搭肩提示。

note.en: Berlin trilogy: Fripp guitar feedback beds, Eno treatments.
note.zh: 柏林三部曲：Fripp 吉他反馈铺底、Eno 处理。

note.en: Rodgers production + Vaughan guitar; 1980s pop-radio scale.
note.zh: Rodgers 制作 + Vaughan 吉他；1980 年代流行电台尺度。

shortBio.en: Solo node: Ziggy glam, Berlin trilogy, Let’s Dance—persona and production as method.
shortBio.zh: 独唱节点：Ziggy glam、柏林三部曲、Let’s Dance——人设与制作即方法。

body.en:
Career hinge tracks run from Space Oddity (1969) through Ziggy Stardust (1972), the Eno collaborations Low/Heroes (1977), and Let’s Dance (1983).

Bowie’s value in this graph is procedural: lineup and style change on purpose, not as crisis. Session players and producers (Mick Ronson, Tony Visconti, Nile Rodgers) matter as much as the characters.
body.zh:
关键曲目从 Space Oddity（1969）经 Ziggy Stardust（1972）、与 Eno 合作的 Low/Heroes（1977），到 Let’s Dance（1983）。

在本图谱里 Bowie 的价值是程序化的：阵容与风格有意切换，而非危机产物。录音室乐手与制作人（Mick Ronson、Tony Visconti、Nile Rodgers）与角色人设同等重要。

title.zh: 人设切换作为工作方法

body.en:
Filed as a band-node: glam, Berlin, and Let’s Dance eras show planned production and costume changes. Session partners (Ronson, Eno, Fripp, Rodgers) are part of the method, not side notes.

Change is the constant, not a crisis narrative.
body.zh:
以乐队节点收录：glam、柏林、Let’s Dance 时期展示有计划的制作与造型切换。录音室伙伴（Ronson、Eno、Fripp、Rodgers）是方法的一部分，不是旁注。

切换是常量，不是危机叙事。

title.en: Ziggy / Berlin / Let’s Dance as lineups
title.zh: Ziggy / 柏林 / Let’s Dance 作为阵容

body.en:
Lineup Versions here mean era teams: Spiders from Mars (Ziggy), Eno/Fripp/Visconti (Berlin), Rodgers/Vaughan (Let’s Dance). Same name; different studio fingerprints.

Use the versions as production chapters.
body.zh:
此处阵容版本即时期团队：Spiders from Mars（Ziggy）、Eno/Fripp/Visconti（柏林）、Rodgers/Vaughan（Let’s Dance）。同一名字；不同录音室指纹。

把版本当制作章节用。

body.en:
Ziggy Stardust cycle: Ronson’s guitar and string arrangements, Bowie’s character vocal. Top of the Pops performance is a UK media hinge for glam visibility.

Space Oddity (1969) remains the earlier chart entry.
body.zh:
Ziggy Stardust 周期：Ronson 吉他与弦乐编排、Bowie 角色人声。Top of the Pops 演出是英国 glam 可见度的媒体铰链。

Space Oddity（1969）仍是更早的榜单入口。

body.en:
Low and Heroes (with Eno) foreground ambient beds, Fripp feedback, Visconti production. Vocal sits inside texture more than arena melisma.

Punk/post-punk neighbors cite the Berlin cool more than Ziggy glitter.
body.zh:
Low 与 Heroes（与 Eno）突出氛围铺底、Fripp 反馈、Visconti 制作。人声坐在纹理里，而非体育场花腔。

朋克/后朋克邻域更多引用柏林冷感，而非 Ziggy 闪光。

title.zh: 不会无聊 / 速成明星

body.en:
Circulated lines sell the procedural claim: change as promise, stardom as constructed. Pair them with named producers and session players.

Quotes are posture evidence, not prophecy.
body.zh:
流传短句卖程序化主张：切换即承诺，明星身份即建构。对照具名制作人与录音室乐手。

引语是姿态证据，不是预言。

body.en:
Radiohead and later alternative acts cite Berlin-era studio mutation. Punk and glam both claim pieces of the costume history.

In this graph: method of changing method.
body.zh:
Radiohead 与后来 alternative 引用柏林时期录音室变异。朋克与 glam 都认领戏服史的一部分。

在本图谱：改变方法的方法。

note.en: Glam character cycle; Hunky Dory through Aladdin Sane orbit.
note.zh: Glam 角色周期；Hunky Dory 至 Aladdin Sane 轨道。

note.en: Low / Heroes / Lodger; texture and ambient beds.
note.zh: Low / Heroes / Lodger；纹理与氛围铺底。
全球流行电台尺度；放克摇滚制作。

note.en: Early chart hinge; Major Tom as recurring character cue.
note.zh: 早期榜单铰链；Major Tom 作为反复角色提示。

note.en: Persona and production shift as deliberate method.
note.zh: 人设与制作切换作为有意方法。
